meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问你平时做什么工作,提议一套专属的记录类型和标签,经你确认后安装成 claude-mem 自定义模式,重启 worker 并验证它确实生效;Telegram 提醒为可选项。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等,或想让某类记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个自定义模式,专门记录法律案例里的规则和考点。
say.note: 它会先问你的工作,再提议记录类型和标签。

say.text: 给 claude-mem 加两种观察类型:实验结论和线上事故。
say.note: 提议分类后会等你确认再安装。

say.text: 记录到带「事故」标签的内容时,用 Telegram 通知我。
say.note: 需先配置好 Telegram 机器人凭证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude asks about your work, proposes note types and tags, installs them as a custom claude-mem mode once you approve, restarts the worker and verifies it; Telegram alerts optional.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or add observation types or tags—even if you don't say "mode".

say_en.text: Create a custom mode that records rules and exam traps from legal cases.
say_en.note: It asks about your work, then proposes types and tags.

say_en.text: Add two observation types to claude-mem: experiment results and incidents.
say_en.note: It waits for your approval before installing.

say_en.text: Alert me on Telegram whenever an "incident" tag is recorded.
say_en.note: Needs a configured Telegram bot token first.
